item.title: House Democrats release new batch of Epstein estate photos featuring Trump, and others
item.description: House Democrats on the Oversight Committee has released a new tranche of photographs from the estate of convicted sex offender Jeffrey Epstein, part of a review of nearly 100,000 images obtained by the committee. The initial release included 19 photos, followed later by about 70 more. item.title: A message from King Charles on cancer treatment and the importance of early diagnosis
item.description: King Charles III said his cancer treatment will be reduced in the new year following early diagnosis and effective treatment. In a recorded message aired Friday, the 77-year-old monarch said early detection had allowed him to continue leading a full and active life. Charles used the message to encourage cancer screening, noting that around 9 million people in the UK are not up to date with checks. item.title: Estonia begins building Baltic bunker line along Russian border
item.description: Estonia has started installing the first concrete bunkers along its southeastern border with Russia as part of the Baltic Defense Line, a trilateral project with Latvia and Lithuania aimed at strengthening NATO's eastern flank. Seven bunkers are currently awaiting installation, with 28 expected by the end of the year, marking the first phase of a planned 600-bunker network. item.title: Netherlands orders Skyranger anti-drone systems
item.description: The Netherlands has ordered Rheinmetall's Skyranger anti-drone air-defence systems for under €1 billion, below the €1.3 billion budget previously indicated to parliament. The deal covers mobile and stationary versions, with deliveries starting in late 2028 and finishing by end-2029.
